integrity_notes: The proof is analytic after an exhaustive exact polyhedral reduction. The bundled checker uses rational arithmetic in \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt2)\); no numerical tolerance is used for the certified inequalities.
scientific_limitations: Real regular-octagonal plane only; finite real exponents \(p\ge1\); no claim for \(p<1\), complex scalars, or other polygons. The literature comparison is finite and may miss uncatalogued equivalent formulations.
title: Exact generalized \(G_L\) profile of the regular octagonal Banach plane
